faq.q: What do I need to open an account?
faq.a: Two passport-size photos, proof of residence such as your latest utility bill, your latest payslip and a valid ID. SmartCash Lite opens instantly with a copy of your ID alone.
The memorandum and articles of association, certificate of incorporation, CR6, CR2 where applicable, a tax clearance, and the directors' IDs and proof of residence.

faq.q: How do I bank on my phone?
faq.a: CBZ Touch is zero-rated on local networks for transfers, bills, school fees and card controls. On any phone, dial *230# for USSD banking.

faq.q: Can I open an account from outside Zimbabwe?
faq.a: Yes. Start on the diaspora banking page with your Zimbabwean ID or passport, proof of your address abroad and proof of income.

regulator: CBZ Bank Limited is a registered commercial bank supervised by the Reserve Bank of Zimbabwe.
productsNote: Requirements, features and benefits are those set out in the Retail Banking Product Manual. Lending is subject to credit assessment, and interest rates are subject to change; confirm current terms before you apply.
